parameters.query:
SELECT id, title, company, location, required_skills, description, educational_attainment_required, status
FROM jobs_catalog
WHERE status = 'Open'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

parameters.subject: Your top recommended jobs on CityJobLink
parameters.html:

Thanks for uploading your resume. Here are your top recommended jobs:

    {{ ($json.recommendations || []).map(r => `
  • ${r.title} - ${r.company} (${r.location}) ${r.score}%
